recap.text: Krakaren monsters pour into rooms as station floors fall away. Gwendolyn Duet tells the screaming chat to fall back to the train lines and hold choke points. When Ronaldo Qu objects, Gwendolyn Duet asks if he is on crack and tells him to clear the chat.

Carl renames a level 27 Boring Ol' Fighter Gwen after she describes fighting scorpion men with nipple rings. Gwen, a five-foot woman with a double-v tattoo, helps Carl wash the Sandcastle of the Mad Dune Mage away. After the beach turns to glass, Gwen is hailed for the throne room. She loots the skeleton of a goose in a golden crown and joins Crawler Katia's party.

Gwendolyn Duet wants to murder Louis and Firas. A pulse rifle punches a grapefruit-sized hole through her midsection, but the wound heals. She dies in a fight against Imogen and lies next to Cleiton, the knock-knock joke guy.
Tran lost both legs in the final moments of the previous floor. Crawler Katia says Tran is more upset about losing Gwen than his legs. Princess Donut delivers a eulogy saying Gwen was mean but liked.

beats.headline: Fall back to the train lines
beats.text: For the record: when the station floors fall away and the Krakaren monsters pour up into the rooms, the chat fills with screaming, and one voice in it is giving orders. Gwendolyn Duet tells everyone that the bomber guy warned all of them, and to fall back to the train lines and hold the choke points. A crawler named Ronaldo Qu objects that he did not say it would be this bad. She asks whether he is on crack, and tells him to clear the chat.
beats.gist: Gwendolyn Duet tells crawlers to fall back to train lines and hold choke points.

beats.headline: The only reply from 543
beats.text: Crawler Carl asks who else is in bubble 543 and gets one answer. Subject: human, level 27, a Boring Ol' Fighter, which is the class's actual name, and vocal in the chats. Her team rolled the land quadrant and the Sandcastle of the Mad Dune Mage, with giant snakes, spiders, scorpion men with nipple rings, and four levels of walls. She holds a Club Vanquisher ring, being a proper lady by her own account. Her name takes up half his screen, so he renames her Gwen.
beats.gist: Carl asks who is in bubble 543 and finds Gwen, a level 27 Boring Ol' Fighter.

beats.headline: Face to face at the sandcastle
beats.text: Crawler Carl lands and finally meets subject: about forty-five, solid, five feet tall, from Canada, a spear over her shoulder, an old double-v tattoo on her forehead and straight-line tattoos down her hands. Level 34 now. Her team has breached the last wall and found a drainage wheel that would wash the castle away, and Crawler Katia has kept her waiting nearly a day so the crawlers can go in the hard way, through the lightning door. Crawler Katia's assessment: once Gwen decides something, she becomes a bully about it.
beats.gist: Carl meets Gwen, a five-foot-tall Level 34 with a spear and a double-v forehead tattoo.

beats.headline: This is where I point out
beats.text: Crawler Carl and Princess Donut are in the castle's basement with the ceiling coming in when he sends subject a note. She asks whether he means electrify it. No, he answers, hurry. Tran opens the valve part way, and the castle goes like sand under a garden hose, taking the two of them down into the water quadrant with it. Subject's first message afterwards: this is where she points out that if he had simply let her open the valve in the first place, they could have avoided whatever that was.
beats.gist: Carl and Donut go into the water quadrant as Tran opens a valve and the castle collapses.

beats.headline: Hailed in the throne room
beats.text: Sandstorm, feral pazuzu, and subject and Crawler Katia moving as one, like a pair of pack hunters, after days of fighting these mobs together. Crawler Carl had subject run the long lead from the drain to the lightning tower. The strike turns the beach to glass around their ankles and sends the current through the temple's water. Bubble Notification: the subterranean quadrant is liberated, and the crawlers hailed for the throne room are Gwendolyn Duet, Low Thi and Morris Sp.
beats.gist: Gwendolyn Duet, Low Thi and Morris Sp are hailed for the throne room.

beats.headline: Into the dry tomb
beats.text: Subject has a new spear, and is pretty stoked about it. With the tomb drained, she and Tran take their team into the subterranean level, loot what is left of the tomb raiders and open the tomb of Anser: a sarcophagus holding the skeleton of a goose in a golden, unenchanted crown. Quetzalcoatlus's corpse holds a partial map of the sixth floor. Her team agrees to join the party Crawler Katia means to form, which Princess Donut notes, given that the two of them are always fighting.
beats.gist: Gwen and Tran loot tomb raiders and find a goose skeleton in a golden crown.

beats.headline: Wants to murder Louis and Firas
beats.text: Crawler Katia's report on her party: big personalities, and they do not all get along. Florin broods like Crawler Carl. Britney has given up on everything. Subject constantly wants to murder Louis and Firas. When Crawler Carl suggests subject for a job Imani may not want, Crawler Katia refuses; she is not going to let Gwen do it either. The party heads southwest the next day, away from elf territory and deeper into the wild.
beats.gist: Gwen wants to murder Louis and Firas.

beats.headline: A grapefruit-sized hole
beats.text: The pulse rifles on this floor are a downright menace: portable guns firing an unending supply of full-strength magic missiles. Bautista almost had his head blown off by one the day before. One has also punched a grapefruit-sized hole clean through subject's midsection. The system does not treat the wound as an amputation, so it heals, and she is back to her normal, grumpy self.
beats.gist: A pulse rifle punches a grapefruit-sized hole through Gwen, but the system heals her.

beats.headline: Beside the knock-knock joke man
beats.text: Gwendolyn Duet is dead. The body lies among dead elves and bugs in the fight against Imogen, next to Cleiton, the knock-knock joke guy. Tran is alive beside them, dragging himself away and screaming; his legs are gone. Crawler Carl reads a scroll over him, and the legs do not grow back. Imogen is still on her feet atop a pile of corpses. Crawler Carl records subject as the woman who had been instrumental in their survival on the previous floor.
beats.gist: Gwendolyn Duet is dead beside Cleiton, the knock-knock joke guy, among dead elves and bugs.

beats.headline: Mean, and liked
beats.text: Filed for the survivors. Tran, who lost both legs in the final moments of the previous floor, is more upset about losing subject than the legs, according to Crawler Katia; they had been together since early on. He does not answer Crawler Carl's note. Princess Donut's eulogy, delivered straight after the fight, begins: poor Gwen, she was mean, but I liked her.
beats.gist: Princess Donut delivers a eulogy for Gwen, saying she was mean but liked.
